interpretation: McIntosh states both coverage and admission/contingency of an aggregate; p15 cites an unread Pruss chapter, which is not directly attributed here. Preserve OTHER: no primitive self-conjunct law is added. Existing BCCFAt covers every contingent fact including the aggregate itself; its exact application requires corresponding inclusion/reflexivity and fact-domain semantics. The totality is a fact, not a collection of concrete individuals.
